snippet.title: Dino Chomp - 3D Dinosaur Maze Iphone Ipad Game
snippet.description:
http://www.PurpleTracks.com
Update: App Launched 21 July 2012 ,download at http://bit.ly/NDDM0d
A soon to be released Iphone/ Ipad 3D maze game by PurpleTracks .  Help the Raptar the dinosaur find and get its egg back.   Help the dinosaur move to find its egg in the randomly created 3 Dimension maze.
Chomp or Stomp on the cavemen because they took its egg away from its nest.  

There are many different themes and levels to choose from.  You can even customize your dinosaur. 

Coming very soon , expected release Mid July!
